title: Deploy a package (Octopus.TentaclePackage)
description: Extracts a package and optionally applies the standard Octopus configuration features.

Octopus.Action.Package.FeedId.label: Feed id
Octopus.Action.Package.FeedId.helpText: Kraken only models the built-in feed today; the value is preserved verbatim for round-trip.

Octopus.Action.EnabledFeatures.label: Enabled features (comma-separated)
Octopus.Action.EnabledFeatures.helpText: Octopus feature ids (e.g. Octopus.Features.CustomDirectory). Per-feature config blocks below appear when the matching feature is listed.

Octopus.Action.Package.CustomInstallatio.label: Installation directory
Octopus.Action.Package.CustomInstallatio.helpText: Where the extracted package is copied. Required when Octopus.Features.CustomDirectory is enabled.

Octopus.Action.Package.CustomInstallatio.label: Purge exclusions
Octopus.Action.Package.CustomInstallatio.helpText: Comma- or newline-separated top-level entry names to keep (e.g. App_Data).

Octopus.Action.Package.AutomaticallyRunC.label: Automatically run XDT transforms
Octopus.Action.Package.AutomaticallyRunC.helpText: Applies *.<env>.config transforms over their base file.

Octopus.Action.Package.AdditionalXmlConf.label: Additional XDT transform mappings
Octopus.Action.Package.AdditionalXmlConf.helpText: Newline-separated. Per line: <transform-file> => <target-file>. (Not yet honoured at runtime; preserved for round-trip.)
